primary.message: code point is outside the XML Char range

notes: XML 1.0 `Char` excludes NUL, C0 controls other than tab, newline, and carriage return, the surrogates U+D800–U+DFFF, and U+FFFE/U+FFFF
diagnostics.help: use `&#NNNN;` (decimal) or `&#xHHHH;` (lowercase `x`, hexadecimal) naming a legal XML character, or remove the reference
spec_references: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) §4.1 Character and Entity References
